name: Pesten
author: Addicting Games
description: Pesten is a puzzle game that is the Dutch version of crazy eights. If you love playing cards and like one with a lot of rules, then this is the online game for you. Play against 3 computer bots who are out to take you for your money’s worth! Each game has 4 rounds and you are out to dominate each one or get the best out of 4. Don’t let these computer bots intimidate you! You are the best of the best! If you’re not one for plain ole’ solitaire and like more of a difficult game that Pesten is one that will entertain you. This is an online card game that is going to challenge your strategy.
